pagerbot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for customer 'Drydock' in dedicated pool drydock-pool (canary slice). 5xx rate 8.3% over baseline, p95 latency +220ms. Paging on-call.

Ana - oncall SRE: seeing the same in dashboards. Errors spike started ~00:05 UTC, correlated with artifact roll c-2028. Request logs show repeated model load failures (OOM-ish) and client timeouts.

Jamie - runtime eng: noted. c-2028 is a quantized build that landed in the canary slice yesterday. Early telemetry flagged higher mem pressure but we let it continue. I'll pull the canary artifact and check kernel logs.

Eve - support SWE: Drydock SRE reported 15% of inference requests failing for them specifically, with timeouts from our side. Customer impact: onboarding flow blocked. They've opened a ticket and are standing by.

Lucas - account lead: flagged to Drydock; they're asking for an immediate mitigation and ETA. They want traffic restored to stable as soon as possible.

Ana - oncall SRE: mitigation proposal: 1) Evict canary traffic for Drydock only (route them to stable artifact c-1974), 2) Pin drydock-pool for stable artifact, 3) Run a targeted rollback of artifact c-2028 out of canary. Can we do that safely?

Jamie - runtime eng: we can divert traffic at the routing layer without a full pool revert. Command to divert:```rbctl route shift --tenant drydock --from=canary --to=stable --pool=drydock-pool --dry-run=false```I'll prepare the pin too.

Ana - oncall SRE: ok execute the divert, then pin. Priya, I'll hand over to you after jamie runs the commands; I'm going to page infra for kernel traces. :eyes:

Priya - oncall SRE (next): acknowledged, I'll take the handoff for post-divert monitoring.

deploy-bot: Deploy action queued: route-shift c-2028 -> stable for tenant drydock in drydock-pool. Job ID: job-8932.

Jamie - runtime eng: running shift now. Output: `started route-shift job-8932`, target stable artifact c-1974.

ops-bot: job-8932: in progress (eta ~30s).

Jamie - runtime eng: job-8932 completed. Route shift success. Drydock traffic now on stable artifact c-1974.

Eve - support SWE: confirmed with Drydock contact — requests are succeeding again, timeouts cleared. They're relieved, asked for a summary and ETA for full rollback.

Ana - oncall SRE: good. Next step: remove c-2028 from canary to prevent recurrence. Jamie, can you trigger a staged rollback from canary pool? Suggest `rbctl artifact remove --pool=drydock-pool --artifact=c-2028 --scope=canary --staged=true`.

Jamie - runtime eng: running artifact removal. Will keep canary healthy by draining sessions first.

deploy-bot: artifact-remove job-8940 started.

Jamie - runtime eng: artifact-remove job-8940 completed. c-2028 removed from canary, stable pinned. I also added an override to routing policy to prefer stable for tenant drydock for 2 hours: `rbctl route override --tenant drydock --prefer=stable --ttl=7200s`.

Ana - oncall SRE: monitoring now. Metrics show error rate back to baseline and latency normalized. No regression in other tenants.

Priya - oncall SRE (next): I'll hold monitoring for 60 mins and then transfer to eng-sre for postmortem. Leaving a check-in reminder.

Lucas - account lead: sent customer note: "We've diverted your traffic to a stable model and removed the canary build from your slice. We're investigating root cause and will share a timeline. Apologies for the disruption." They replied :+1:.

Eve - support SWE: customer asked for a permanent pin until patch is validated. I'll capture that in the ticket.

Ana - oncall SRE: action items: - Runtime to investigate why c-2028 increased memory pressure (Jamie) - Infra to collect kernel traces and OOM logs (Ana) - Support to relay customer pin request (Eve) - Postmortem in 24h and follow-up with Drydock (Lucas)

Jamie - runtime eng: initial hypothesis: quantization change caused larger ephemeral KV cache usage under certain sequence length patterns for Drydock workload. Will reproduce in lab and run a canary with memory limits tightened.

ops-bot: NOTE: automated health checks flagged routing override. Audit log entry created: audit-5592.

Ana - oncall SRE: closing paging but leaving this thread open until postmortem artifacts are attached. If anyone sees reappearance, @pagerbot escalate to P0.

deploy-bot: job-8932 and job-8940: archived.

Priya - oncall SRE (next): taking over monitoring now, thanks Ana.

Lucas - account lead: I'll schedule a follow-up call with Drydock for 16:00 UTC to walk through next steps and timeline.

Eve - support SWE: adding customer request to support ticket and requested follow-up contact.

Ana - oncall SRE: thanks all. Postmortem doc will be created in #postmortems/drydock-dedicated-c2028 within 24h. :spiral_note_pad:

Jamie - runtime eng: adding initial notes to the internal tracker and linking telemetry graphs.

pagerbot: Incident resolved for Drydock canary slice. If metrics degrade, new alert will reopen this thread.
